name: Flamme en Feu
description: Phoenix Primordial renaissant éternellement de ses cendres pour guider la vengeance des Héritiers et inspirer leur rage combattante.

subject.archetype: Flamme en Feu, the Phoenix Primordial Ascendant

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered anti‑radiation robes made of fused ash‑cloth, tribal bone and rusted metal plating, asymmetric shoulder spikes, a tattered hood stitched with glowing radioactive glyphs, a collar of spent nuclear capsules, skin grafted with metallic implants
loadout.arsenal: High‑technology plasma cannon fused to the forearm, wrist‑chained anti‑matter rifle, small nuclear warhead worn as a melee relic, crown of blazing plasma energy

attitude.behavior: Emerging from a swirling column of ash and fire, wings spread wide, one hand thrust upward holding a blazing plasma relic as a beacon of vengeance, the other gripping a chain‑bound anti‑matter rifle, eyes ablaze with radioactive fire, exuding an aura of relentless fury and guidance
attitude.emotion: Fierce, vengeful, inspirational fury, a cold calculating resolve masked by primal heat

palette_names.name: Radioactive Neon Yellow
palette_names.role: glowing tumors, eyes, and energy cores

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim light with warm fire tones contrasted by cool radioactive blue‑violet highlights, volumetric ash fog, subtle lens flare from plasma weapons

scenography.setting: Ruined nuclear silo battlefield, twisted metal debris, shattered concrete pillars, a cracked dome of a collapsed reactor in the far background
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Radiation haze, drifting ash and ember particles, flickering firelight, occasional glitching holographic whispers of ancient war cries, subtle blue‑violet plasma discharge
